long_biography.plain_text:
Tom Cruz began earning money by building websites while studying finance at the University of North Carolina Wilmington. A condominium bought before the financial crisis became a profitable rental, directing him towards property. He then wholesaled houses and accumulated lower-cost single-family homes, increasingly leasing them through the federal Housing Choice Voucher programme.

His expansion included a partnership that acquired 93 rental units in Wilmington, followed by a wider portfolio across several states. Cruz built an online audience around Section 8 investing and extended the model into investor education and property-management software. The Wilmington portfolio later faced repeated municipal housing-code violations; he acknowledged that early property management had not kept pace with growth.
